# Extension names PIXI 5.3.12 calls getExtension with on a WebGL2 context,
# and whether Chrome 117.0.5938.63 (ANGLE) returned an object for each one.
# Recorded from PIXI's own getExtensions/validateContext paths; WebGL2 core
# removes the WebGL1-only names, which therefore answer null in Chrome too.
# Format: <name> <yes|no>; comments and blank lines are ignored.
ANGLE_instanced_arrays no
EXT_color_buffer_float yes
EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic yes
MOZ_OES_vertex_array_object no
OES_element_index_uint no
OES_texture_float no
OES_texture_float_linear yes
OES_texture_half_float no
OES_texture_half_float_linear no
OES_vertex_array_object no
WEBGL_depth_texture no
WEBGL_draw_buffers no
WEBGL_lose_context yes
WEBKIT_OES_vertex_array_object no
